Class VulkanRenderPassSet

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.core.RefCnt
icyllis.arc3d.vulkan.VulkanRenderPassSet
All Implemented Interfaces:
RefCounted
public final class VulkanRenderPassSet extends RefCnt
Defines a compatibility domain and provides a set of VkRenderPass that are compatible with each other.

This object is tracked and managed by VulkanGraphicsPipeline. And this object manages VulkanRenderPass and also VulkanRenderPassFramebuffer.

This class and held objects can ONLY be used on ExecutingThread only.
